_note: Object physics ranges: NOT measured. Each run samples one value per object from these ranges (uniform); the viewer (src/objphys.ts) and the offline batch (physics/batch_mujoco.py) both read this file. Heights and shapes come from the splat; everything here is an assumption until measured.

mat._flap: curled corner: a hinged triangle; stiffness = how hard the curl springs back (N m per rad)
mat._batch_curl: offline batch only, when the scene's mat shows no curled corner: an ASSUMED curl (lift, flap size) so P(corner folds) can still be estimated; reported as assumed geometry

rug_loose._fit: CALIBRATED (physics/rug_calib.py, MuJoCo cloth rug) to 8 real walker passes over a loose cotton rug, data/recording_notes.csv: the range where the sim disturbs the rug at about the real rate in both directions; read by rug_calib.py only, the scene's mat keeps the mat range

walker._glide_rug: rear glide on rug pile, CALIBRATED with rug_loose.floor_friction (rug_calib.py); glide caps / tennis balls ASSUMED 0.10-0.20 (physics/rug_calib.json glide_caps_mu_assumed)
walker._frame_mass: Drive Medical 10210-1 spec sheet: 7.5 lb (manufacturer, not weighed)
